description: List what lies in one warehouse of a workspace that keeps stock per warehouse, product by product: quantity, reservedQuantity (held by open orders), status (in_stock, low, out), threshold and the product's total stock, 50 per page with counts of products, units, low and out over the whole warehouse. For an Amazon FBA warehouse the figures are Amazon's from its last hourly read (quantity = ready to ship + reserved). Read-only. Use list_warehouses for the id, get_product for one product across every warehouse; refused when the workspace keeps one count per product.

filter.description: Which rows: all (default), low — at or below the warehouse's low-stock mark, or out — none available here after reservations.

q.description: Search by product name or SKU (optional).

warehouseId.description: The warehouse id returned by list_warehouses.

name: list_warehouse_stock
title: List warehouse stock
